source: Peak firmware 2.2, mapping runs 2026-11-09 (Tests/fixtures/mapping); run 3 (menu walk + 4 dumps) added envelope/LFO/delay/FX-matrix menu parameters

params.name: Osc3 Fine
params.note: Peak ignores CC 21 (MSB) for some values: 45/47/44 (MSB 22/23) never applied across two runs; 108-200 fine. Firmware quirk.

params.name: LFO1 Repeats
params.note: Manual chart calls this One Shot 0-1; the menu (and dump) is Repeats Off,1-127 (run 3).

params.name: LFO2 Repeats
params.note: Manual chart calls this One Shot 0-1; the menu (and dump) is Repeats Off,1-127 (run 3).

params.name: Reverb Type
params.note: Coupled with Reverb Size: setting Type loads a preset Size (1->64, 2->127); setting Size re-derives Type (e.g. 9,26->0, 63->1, 92->2). Send Size after Type.

params.name: Reverb Size
params.note: See Reverb Type coupling.
